name: Guru Nanak College
summary: Guru Nanak College was founded in 1971 by the Guru Nanak Educational Society to mark the 500th birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji. It is an autonomous Sikh minority college on a 25-acre campus on Guru Nanak Salai, Velachery, between Raj Bhavan and IIT Madras, with 28 UG programmes and 7,500+ students across a government-aided Shift I and self-financing streams. Admission is on Class XII marks through community-wise merit lists.

totalStudents.notes: "7500+ students on campus across two shifts".
